criteria.text: Treatment of wounds in patients with dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (DEB) with COL7A1 mutation(s) (FDA indication; approval criterion 3).
Patient is 6 months of age or older (FDA labeled age; approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist (approval criterion 2).
COL7A1 gene mutation confirmed by genetic testing (approval criterion 4).
Documentation of baseline size of target wounds has been provided (approval criterion 5).
Provider attests that all wounds to be treated have adequate granulation tissue, are well vascularized, and have no evidence of active infection or squamous cell carcinoma (approval criterion 6a–d).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Vyjuvek (beremagene geperpavec-svdt). Version: 1; Original: 10/20/2023; Accepted: 11/17/2023; Effective: 01/1/2024. The PDF spells the generic beramagene geperpavec-svdt.

Encoded: closed FDA indication and approval criteria 1–6. Diagnosis is covered by the indication. Denial criterion 1 (failure to meet approval criteria) is covered by the approval clauses; no additional denial predicates.

Wound readiness is one combined provider attestation requiring all of 6a–d: adequate granulation tissue, well vascularized tissue, no evidence of active infection, and no evidence of squamous cell carcinoma.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 6 months; reauthorization approval up to 6 months.
Quantity (notes only): ages 6 months to <3 years: 3.2 mL per 28 days; ages ≥3 years: 6.4 mL per 28 days. HCPCS J3401. No numeric quantity enforcement; max_units is null.
Cautions (notes only): safety in pregnancy or lactation has not been established. Avoid direct contact with treated wounds and dressings for approximately 24 hours following application.

Remaining gaps: genetic testing and baseline wound size documentation verification, wound readiness, duration, reauthorization, quantity enforcement and cautions require manual review. Genetic confirmation, baseline documentation and wound readiness are attestations.
PDL status unknown. No evaluate-linked alternatives.
